description: Illustrative local demo checks only; not official AICTE requirements.

DOC_REQUIRED.name: Required document missing
DOC_REQUIRED.recommended_action: Upload the illustrative required document or confirm the requirement with an authorized reviewer.

FIELD_REQUIRED.name: Required field unavailable
FIELD_REQUIRED.recommended_action: Review the source document and enter or confirm this value manually.

DOCUMENT_EXPIRED.name: Document is expired
DOCUMENT_EXPIRED.recommended_action: Request a current document and have a reviewer confirm the expiry date.

DATE_UNPARSEABLE.name: Expiry date needs review
DATE_UNPARSEABLE.recommended_action: Review the date as printed on the source document.

INSTITUTION_MISMATCH.name: Institution name mismatch
INSTITUTION_MISMATCH.recommended_action: Compare the application and document; resolve spelling or identity differences with a reviewer.

DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT.name: Exact duplicate file
DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT.recommended_action: Confirm whether the duplicate upload is intentional and retain the correct copy.

SUSPICIOUS_METADATA.name: Metadata indicator requires review
SUSPICIOUS_METADATA.recommended_action: Inspect the original document; this metadata indicator alone is not proof of alteration.

LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION.name: Extraction requires manual review
LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION.recommended_action: Open the original document and manually verify extracted content.
